title: "Scheduled Clinical Insights"
subtitle: "AI-Assisted Quarto Reporting for Oncology Studies"
author: Matthew Kumar
date: 2026-06-16
date-format: "MMMM D, YYYY"
format:
  revealjs:
    scrollable: true
    embed-resources: true
    pagetitle: "Scheduled Clinical Insights — Matthew Kumar"
    include-in-header:
      - text: |
          <style>
          .title-logo {
            position: absolute;
            top: 24px;
            height: 72px;
            width: auto;
            z-index: 20;
          }
          .title-logo-right { right: 24px; }
          </style>
    include-before-body:
      - text: |
          <img src="bayer-logo.svg" class="title-logo title-logo-right" alt="Bayer">
    include-after-body:
      - text: |
          <script>
          function colorizeTitleSlide() {
            const title = document.querySelector("#title-slide .title");
            if (!title || title.dataset.colorized) return;
            const words = title.textContent.trim().split(/\s+/);
            if (words.length !== 3) return;
            title.innerHTML = words
              .map((word, i) => `<span class="title-word-${i}">${word}</span>`)
              .join(" ");
            title.dataset.colorized = "1";
          }
          function colorizeSectionTitleSlides() {
            document.querySelectorAll("section.section-title-slide h2, section.demo-slide h2").forEach(h2 => {
              if (h2.dataset.colorized) return;
              const words = h2.textContent.trim().split(/\s+/);
              if (words.length === 0) return;
              h2.innerHTML = `<span class="title-first-word">${words[0]}</span>${words.length > 1 ? " " + words.slice(1).join(" ") : ""}`;
              h2.dataset.colorized = "1";
            });
          }
          function toggleTitleLogo(indexh) {
            const display = indexh === 0 ? "" : "none";
            document.querySelectorAll("img.title-logo").forEach(img => {
              img.style.display = display;
            });
          }
          function toggleSectionTitleSlideTheme(slide) {
            const onSectionTitle =
              slide && slide.classList.contains("section-title-slide");
            document.querySelector(".reveal")?.classList.toggle(
              "viewport-on-section-title",
              !!onSectionTitle
            );
            document.body.classList.toggle("section-title-viewport", !!onSectionTitle);
          }
          function prepareRoughNotationSlides() {
            document.querySelectorAll("section.rough-notation-slide").forEach(slide => {
              slide.querySelectorAll(".item .annotation .rn-fragment").forEach(el => {
                el.classList.remove("fragment");
              });
              if (slide.classList.contains("background-slide") || slide.classList.contains("what-we-did-slide") || slide.classList.contains("what-we-learned-slide") || slide.classList.contains("directions-slide")) {
                slide.querySelectorAll("li .rn-fragment").forEach(el => {
                  el.classList.remove("fragment");
                });
              }
            });
            if (typeof window.quartoDiagramsRelayoutProcesses === "function") {
              window.quartoDiagramsRelayoutProcesses(Reveal.getCurrentSlide());
            }
            if (typeof Reveal.sync === "function") Reveal.sync();
          }
          const backgroundRoughAnnotations = new WeakMap();
          function showBackgroundRoughNotation(el) {
            if (!el?.classList.contains("rn-fragment") || typeof RoughNotation === "undefined") return;
            if (!backgroundRoughAnnotations.has(el)) {
              const opts = {
                type: el.dataset.rnType || "highlight",
                animate: el.dataset.rnAnimate !== "false",
                animateOnHide: true,
                animationDuration: parseInt(el.dataset.rnAnimationduration, 10) || 800,
                color: el.dataset.rnColor || "#fff17680",
                strokeWidth: parseInt(el.dataset.rnStrokewidth, 10) || 1,
                multiline: el.dataset.rnMultiline !== "false",
                iterations: parseInt(el.dataset.rnIterations, 10) || 2,
                rtl: el.dataset.rnRtl === "true",
                padding: el.dataset.rnPadding
                  ? (el.dataset.rnPadding.includes(",")
                    ? el.dataset.rnPadding.split(",").map(v => parseInt(v.trim(), 10))
                    : parseInt(el.dataset.rnPadding, 10))
                  : 5,
              };
              if (opts.type === "bracket") {
                opts.brackets = el.dataset.rnBrackets
                  ? (el.dataset.rnBrackets.includes(",")
                    ? el.dataset.rnBrackets.split(",").map(v => v.trim())
                    : el.dataset.rnBrackets)
                  : "right";
              }
              backgroundRoughAnnotations.set(el, RoughNotation.annotate(el, opts));
            }
            const annotation = backgroundRoughAnnotations.get(el);
            annotation.show();
            if (annotation._svg && typeof Reveal.getScale === "function") {
              const scale = Reveal.getScale();
              annotation._svg.style.transform = `scale(${1 / scale})`;
              annotation._svg.style.transformOrigin = "top left";
            }
          }
          function triggerBackgroundListRoughNotation(listItem) {
            if (!listItem) return;
            listItem.querySelectorAll(".rn-fragment").forEach(showBackgroundRoughNotation);
          }
          if (!window._backgroundRoughNotationBound) {
            Reveal.addEventListener("ready", () => {
              Reveal.on("fragmentshown", event => {
                const frag = event.fragment;
                if (!frag || !(frag.closest("section.background-slide") || frag.closest("section.what-we-did-slide") || frag.closest("section.what-we-learned-slide") || frag.closest("section.directions-slide"))) return;
                if (frag.tagName === "LI") triggerBackgroundListRoughNotation(frag);
              });
            });
            window._backgroundRoughNotationBound = true;
          }
          Reveal.addEventListener("ready", e => {
            colorizeTitleSlide();
            colorizeSectionTitleSlides();
            toggleTitleLogo(e.indexh);
            toggleSectionTitleSlideTheme(e.currentSlide);
            setTimeout(prepareRoughNotationSlides, 250);
          });
          Reveal.addEventListener("slidechanged", e => {
            toggleTitleLogo(e.indexh);
            toggleSectionTitleSlideTheme(e.currentSlide);
            setTimeout(prepareRoughNotationSlides, 250);
          });
          </script>

## Problem Space {.section-title-slide}

## Background {.background-slide .rough-notation-slide}

::: incremental
- [Early oncology]{.rn-fragment rn-type=underline rn-color="#00BCFF"} studies bring significant complexity, from novel therapies to unconventional trial designs and vulnerable patient populations
- Timely insight from emerging data is essential for high-impact development decisions
- Traditional reporting tools are often [too constrained]{.rn-fragment rn-type=underline rn-color="#00BCFF"} for exploratory or fast-changing analytical needs
- Bespoke analysis requests can create delays that are misaligned with decision timelines
- The need is for a [faster]{.bayer-blue-emphasis}, more adaptable reporting approach that still maintains rigor in a regulated environment
:::

## Previous Work {.section-title-slide}

## What we did {.what-we-did-slide .rough-notation-slide}

::: incremental
- <div class="what-we-did-row"><span>Started with a deterministic Shiny review app for baseline and efficacy exploration</span><img src="shiny.svg" alt="" class="what-we-did-hex"></div>

- <div class="what-we-did-row"><span>Added an experimental LLM layer based on <span class="bayer-blue-emphasis">querychat</span> for natural-language filtering and data analysis</span><img src="querychat.webp" alt="" class="what-we-did-hex"></div>

- <div class="what-we-did-row"><span>Developed <span class="bayer-blue-emphasis">ellmer tools</span> to create novel figures and tables (with R code returned) and one-click interpretation of standard plots</span><span class="what-we-did-hex-group"><img src="ellmer.svg" alt="ellmer" class="what-we-did-hex"><img src="ggplot2.svg" alt="ggplot2" class="what-we-did-hex"><img src="tplyr.png" alt="Tplyr" class="what-we-did-hex"></span></div>

- <div class="what-we-did-row"><span>A [complementary]{.rn-fragment rn-type=underline rn-color="#00BCFF"} approach worked well: a Shiny foundation for reliable review, with the LLM accelerating exploration and driving insight in the last mile</span><span class="what-we-did-check" aria-hidden="true">✓</span></div>

- <a href="https://phuse.s3.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com/Archive/2026/Connect/US/Austin/PAP_ML20.pdf" class="paper-link">PHUSE US Connect 2026 paper<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><line x1="2" y1="12" x2="22" y2="12"/><path d="M12 2a15.3 15.3 0 0 1 4 10 15.3 15.3 0 0 1-4 10 15.3 15.3 0 0 1-4-10 15.3 15.3 0 0 1 4-10z"/></svg></a>
:::

## What we learned {.what-we-learned-slide .rough-notation-slide}

::: incremental
- Users generally liked the LLM features, especially plot interpretation as a quick "second set of eyes"
- Reception was [mixed]{.rn-fragment rn-type=underline rn-color="#FF3162"}: some users were less comfortable with open-ended AI generation
- For some reviewers, a full Shiny app [was more]{.rn-fragment rn-type=underline rn-color="#FF3162"} than they needed; they already knew the exact views they wanted
:::

::: {.fragment .llm-thinking-wrap}
<span class="llm-thinking">Thinking...</span>
:::

::: incremental
- A [simpler]{.rn-fragment rn-type=underline rn-color="#00BCFF"} path: a static [scheduled]{.rn-fragment rn-type=underline rn-color="#00BCFF" rn-animate="true" rn-animationduration="600"} report with fixed visuals, plus LLM insights, [delivered]{.rn-fragment rn-type=underline rn-color="#00BCFF" rn-animate="true" rn-animationduration="600"} to the reviewer inbox
:::

## Future {.section-title-slide}

## Directions {.directions-slide .rough-notation-slide}

::: incremental
- Most of this experiment is for [feasibility]{.rn-fragment rn-type=box rn-color="#00BCFF" rn-animate="true" rn-animationduration="600"}

- Continue the journey by refining the pipeline, prompts, and guardrails as we learn

  - [**vitals**](https://vitals.tidyverse.org) is a framework for evaluating LLM outputs with ellmer
  - Systematic prompt comparisons, model grading, and inspectable eval logs

- Explore [**pins**](https://pins.tidyverse.org) storage backends, including **AWS S3 buckets**

- Embed prior reports in the RAG process to surface the delta and journey of issues, findings, and insights over time

- Onboard new users to gauge receptiveness and gather further feedback
:::

::: {.notes}
Future work: iterate on prompts and process using vitals evals, expand the user base for feedback, and enrich Ragnar context with historical reports so narratives can reference how findings evolved.
:::
